As of this 2026-08-11 capture, this generic Multiple Choice Exams page (which duration and passing-score facts are also drawn from generically and applied to LFCA by the certification page's own 'Multiple Choice Exam' classification, per the reasoning already in exam-mechanics.md Section 2) now states 60 questions, with the same 'generic rule + CNPA exception' structure as the existing duration statement. This numeral (60) matches the previously-dismissed third-party figure. Per task instructions this value is NOT folded into exam-mechanics.md's 'Question count' section as an adopted fact -- it is recorded here, quoted in lf-important-instructions-mc.txt, and flagged at the top of the task report for explicit human decision before any downstream task (especially the question-bank build) treats it as authoritative.
